scope: F2 fold-0 screen. New feature block: Smoothed categorical model - generalizes rare categorical configurations via smoothing/regularization.

H54_SMOOTHED_CATEGORICAL.question: Does smoothing rare categorical configurations (Bayesian smoothing of categorical levels) improve fold-0 OOF AUC?
H54_SMOOTHED_CATEGORICAL.method: For each categorical feature, compute smoothed target statistics with Bayesian shrinkage (prior from global mean). Cross-fit: compute statistics on folds 1-4, apply to fold-0. Add smoothed features to 21raw. LGBM fold-0.
H54_SMOOTHED_CATEGORICAL.leakage: Smoothing statistics computed on FIT only (folds 1-4). Applied to fold-0. Fold-safe.
H54_SMOOTHED_CATEGORICAL.decision_rule: PROMISING if fold-0 port_delta >= +5e-5 AND corr_vs_portfolio < 0.995.
